correctness.rationale: The finite object is fully defined by two-subsets and disjointness. Its 45-by-45 Laplacian is exhaustively reconstructed. Exact Bareiss determinant and Newton-identity characteristic polynomial independently agree through the matrix-tree theorem. Local modular row/column Smith eliminations at all five determinant primes yield all 44 elementary valuations, whose assembled invariant factors are a divisor chain with product equal to the determinant; standalone verify.py replays each step. Risk: ordinary implementation error, mitigated by algebraically distinct determinant and trace checks.

value.rationale: This computes a natural complete integral invariant of a canonical nonregular 45-vertex two-particle configuration graph, beyond known spectra and chip-firing group orders. It determines all prime-primary torsion and the exact 49,253,533,675,382,566,432,014,336,000 recurrent-state count, supporting candidate structural arithmetic formulas for symmetric powers. The full invariant-factor list is not forced by a known base-graph group or spectral theorem. No infinite-family claim is made.
